immediate_dom_behavior: The selected tab remains on the prior confirmed target until Herdr confirms the new target. This matches the user contract.

rapid_input_attempt.reason: The current browser bundle logged repeated terminal WebSocket 503/closed-before-establishment responses while rapidly switching pane streams. This is retained as a runtime issue rather than a false PASS.

console.errors: terminal WebSocket handshake returned 503 during rapid stream switching

native_clipboard.reason: No separate native clipboard adapter exists; Tauri uses the same WebView navigator.clipboard path. Native app launch requires a stable Herdr server.
